subject: SIG vendor questionnaire initiation / SOC 2 + HIPAA clarifications
messages:
From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up: SIG questionnaire initiation / SOC 2 + HIPAA clarifications

Hi Sarah — great to speak today, thanks for the time. Quick recap and next steps from our call: 

- Scope: Acme Health would like to confirm Redwood's controls for hosting PHI and understand our SOC 2 posture and encryption/data residency capabilities.
- Immediate ask: your team requested we start the SIG questionnaire (you mentioned SIG Lite as an option) and to clarify a few HIPAA/GDPR items up front so you can prioritize.

Attachments: I've attached a short SOC 2 summary and a SIG starter template (Excel) to this thread for your security team to begin.

Short answers up front: 
- SOC 2: Redwood completed a SOC 2 Type II audit in 2024; full report available under NDA. I've attached the one-page summary for now.
- HIPAA: We support HIPAA-covered workloads via a BAA. We can provide the BAA and relevant architecture diagrams on request.
- Data residency & encryption: Data at rest is encrypted with customer-managed KMS options (AWS/Azure/GCP). We support region pinning for Dedicated/Private deployments; for Hosted API we can route to region-specific endpoints — we can confirm specific region availability for Acme's preferred cloud/provider.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Please confirm if you want us to complete the SIG Lite (faster) or full SIG (CAIQ style / Excel) — I attached the Excel version to this email.
2) If you prefer, we can have our security lead (Marissa) fill out the questionnaire directly — or you can send it back to me and I'll coordinate.
3) Let us know any timeline constraints (procurement deadlines).

If helpful I can schedule a 30-min follow-up with our security engineer to walk through any technical evidence requests.

Thanks again,

— Camila Reyes
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments:
- redwood-soc2-summary-202405.pdf (1 page summary)
- AcmeHealth_SIG_Template.xlsx (SIG starter template)

From: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmehealth.com>
To: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 9 Jun 2026 16:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG questionnaire initiation / SOC 2 + HIPAA clarifications

Thanks Camila — helpful summary. A couple of clarifying questions before we kick off the SIG: 

1) For HIPAA: does Redwood sign a BAA for hosted API customers, or is that only for Dedicated/Private customers? Our legal team needs that clarified.
2) SOC 2: great — is the full Type II report downloadable via a secure link (we can do an NDA), or do you require it to be shared via a secure portal only?
3) Pen testing / external assessments: do you have a most recent penetration test report or scope we can review?
4) For the SIG spreadsheet: do you prefer we return the completed Excel, or do you accept DocuSign/secure upload? Procurement has a deadline of 2026-06-25.

If Marissa is available to join a short call tomorrow afternoon, that would help.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Jones 
Security Program Manager | Acme Health
sarah.jones@acmehealth.com

Procurement CC: procurement@acmehealth.com

From: Camila Reyes <camila@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jones <sarah.jones@acmehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Jun 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up: SIG questionnaire initiation / SOC 2 + HIPAA clarifications

Hi Sarah — looping in Marissa (Security Lead) and Jordan (Legal/Sales) to answer the specifics. Answers below: 

1) BAA: We do sign BAAs for customers handling PHI on both Dedicated and Hosted offerings. For Hosted, we have a standard BAA template; we can provide a redline-ready copy.

2) SOC 2 report: we can share the full SOC 2 Type II report under NDA. We typically use a secure file portal for distribution — happy to provision access once an NDA is in place.

3) Pen test: Our most recent third-party penetration test was completed in 2025; we can provide an executive summary and scope. Full reports are gated (sensitive findings) but we can provide evidence of remediation for any relevant findings.

4) SIG format & return: Excel (the SIG spreadsheet) is fine and often easiest. We can also accept completed PDFs or a secure upload link. If procurement prefers DocuSign for legal signatures, that works for the BAA portion only.

Timeline: noted — we can prioritize to meet your 2026-06-25 procurement deadline. If you send back the SIG by next Tue (6/16) we should be able to complete review and evidence upload in time.

Marissa / Jordan — can you confirm availability for a 30-min sync tomorrow (Wed) afternoon PDT to review any technical evidence requests?

Thanks,
Camila

Attachment: AcmeHealth_SIG_Template.xlsx

— Sarah
